versions.content: . 10.3.5 Signal Gateway Configuration [SWS_Com_CONSTR_00384] Routed Signal Size Configuration The ComBit- Size of a received and to be routed ComSignal shall not differ.

Large Data Path TX I-PDU Excluded Features If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection SEND , then the following parameters and containers shall not be configured for the ComTx- IPdu : • ComTxIPduClearUpdateBit • ComTxIPduUnusedAreasDefault • ComTxModeFalse • ComTxModeTrue
